jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - Oil & Gas EPC Saudi Arabia
jobs.description:
About CPECC:
China Petroleum Engineering & Construction Corp (CPECC) is a leading EPC contractor in the oil & gas industry, delivering world-class pipeline, processing, and infrastructure projects across the Middle East and globally.

Position: Electrical Engineer
Project: Oil & Gas EPC Pipeline Projects (Saudi Arabia)
Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

Job Responsibilities:
- Lead electrical engineering and field installation activities for oil & gas EPC projects.
- Review and approve electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, cable schedules, and equipment layouts.
- Supervise installation and commissioning of HV/LV switchgear, transformers, MCC panels, and motors.
- Manage cable pulling, termination, and electrical testing activities.
- Coordinate with instrumentation, piping, and civil teams for integrated execution.
- Ensure compliance with Saudi Aramco electrical standards (SAES-P series), IEC, and NEC codes.
- Conduct pre-commissioning, energization, and functional testing of electrical systems.
- Interface with Saudi Aramco inspection and commissioning teams.
- Lead and mentor electrical supervisors, foremen, and technicians.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
- 10+ years of hands-on experience in electrical construction and installation for oil & gas EPC projects.
- Proven experience on Saudi Aramco projects is a strong advantage.
- Proficient in Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards (SAES-P), IEC 60364, IEEE.
- Strong experience with HV/LV power systems, earthing, lighting, and cathodic protection.
- Familiar with hazardous area classification (ATEX/IECEx) requirements.
- Ability to read single-line diagrams, cable schedules, and electrical drawings.
- Strong leadership, coordination, and technical problem-solving skills.
- Fluent in English; Arabic or Chinese is a plus.
- Valid Saudi Iqama or willingness to relocate to Saudi Arabia.

What We Offer:
- Competitive expat salary package.
- Accommodation, transportation, and medical benefits provided.
- Opportunity to work on landmark Saudi Arabia energy infrastructure projects.
- Career growth within a global EPC organization.

jobs.title: HSE Engineer
jobs.description:
HSE Engineer
Work Location: Dammam, Saudi Arabia

Job Responsibilities:
- Take overall responsibility for on-site Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) management. Develop and implement project HSE plans, safety regulations, and emergency response plans in strict accordance with local Saudi standards and codes.
- Organize mandatory pre-entry safety induction, professional safety training, and regular emergency drills. These cover working at height, crane lifting operations, hot work, temporary power utilization, confined space operation, and deep foundation pit construction. Ensure full safety disclosure and certified operation of all on-site staff.
- Conduct daily comprehensive site patrols to identify potential safety hazards in a timely manner. Issue hazard rectification notices, track the rectification process, and manage closed-loop safety procedures. Establish complete safety ledgers, focusing on risk control and supervision of high-risk construction procedures such as high-altitude operation, hoisting operation, deep foundation pit construction, temporary electricity use, and mechanical operation.
- Supervise the construction behaviors of subcontractors, suppliers, and third-party personnel to ensure full compliance with Saudi local safety specifications and project HSE management requirements. Audit and verify the HSE construction plans, qualification certificates, and staff training records of all subcontractors.
- Take charge of on-site occupational health management and medical support. Strictly implement PPE wearing specifications and occupational disease prevention measures. Manage and control high temperature, dust, and noise hazards at the construction site. Standardize the disposal process of construction waste, on-site dust, domestic sewage, and hazardous materials to meet local environmental compliance requirements.
- Conduct on-site investigation of safety accidents and near-miss incidents. Analyze root causes of risks, formulate targeted rectification schemes and preventive measures, and complete relevant reports and file archiving. Independently compile HSE daily, weekly, and monthly reports, meeting minutes, and all compliance certification documents.
- Actively liaise and communicate with the Saudi Ministry of Labor, municipal government, and relevant regulatory authorities. Ensure all project construction activities fully comply with Saudi Building Code (SBC), industrial specifications, and local environmental protection laws and regulations. Complete relevant approval and filing work.
- Promote the construction of on-site safety culture. Organize safety assessment, safety publicity, and special HSE promotion activities continuously. Iterate and optimize the project HSE management system to reduce construction risks.

Job Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree or above in Safety Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, or other related engineering majors.
- At least 3 years of formal HSE management working experience in infrastructure, building construction, or municipal engineering projects. Candidates with Saudi Arabia or Middle East on-site construction experience are highly preferred.
- Priority will be given to candidates holding Saudi government-approved safety certificates, OSHA, NEBOSH, ISO45001, and other authoritative safety certification qualifications. Familiarity with Saudi Building Code (SBC) and local project safety approval and filing processes is required.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office software. Possess outstanding risk identification ability, on-site execution, and cross-department communication and coordination capabilities. Able to be stationed at the Dammam construction site for long-term on-site work.
- Fluent in English (used as the daily working language). Arabic proficiency is a bonus. Strong sense of responsibility and pressure resistance, capable of independently judging and handling various on-site safety emergencies and abnormal situations.

jobs.title: International Logistics Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Responsibilities

- Demonstrate strong internal collaboration capabilities, working efficiently with R&D, production, quality, procurement, finance, and other departments to support business operations.

jobs.title: Senior Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Key Account Manager (KSA) – Ansen Technology

About Ansen Technology
Ansen Technology is a global AI-empowered cybersecurity leader, serving governments, critical infrastructure, telecom, energy, and enterprises worldwide. With a global operations center in Abu Dhabi and offices across APAC, MENA, and North America, Ansen focuses on:
- Government-grade security solutions
- National-level SOC projects
- Memory security (MDPS)
- Advanced threat protection (ATP)
- Managed Detection and Response/Extended Detection and Response (MDR/XDR)
- Endpoint and cloud security
- Compliance services covering NESA, SAMA, NCA, PDPL, ISO27001, GDPR, etc.
Ansen holds CREST certification in MENA and serves numerous Fortune 500 clients and core government agencies.

About the Role (Riyadh, KSA)
- Lead business development and key account management activities in Saudi Arabia
- Drive the full sales cycle (LTC): lead generation, pre-sales, proposal, negotiation, contract, and payment collection
- Build and manage relationships with C-level and senior stakeholders in government, critical infrastructure, telecom, and energy sectors
- Collaborate cross-functionally with solution, delivery, and finance teams to ensure project success
- Represent Ansen at industry events to strengthen the company’s brand presence in KSA

Requirements
- Minimum 5 years’ experience in KSA/GCC business development, key account management, or cybersecurity sales
- Proven track record in complex cybersecurity or ICT solution sales
- Deep understanding of SOC, PenTest, MDR/XDR, endpoint, cloud, and identity security solutions
- Familiarity with KSA compliance, procurement processes, and local regulations
- Fluent in English and Arabic; willingness to travel frequently within KSA and GCC

If you are interested in this high-impact leadership role, please share your latest CV for our review. We look forward to discussing further details with you.
